title: Debited but Payment Failed
description: If the bank or gateway confirms a successful debit but the payment was not completed in our system, the customer is eligible for a reconciliation refund.

title: Refund Pending
description: An initiated refund that is still pending is being processed and is awaiting bank settlement.

title: Payment Dispute Window
description: A customer can raise a dispute on a completed payment within 10 days if the service was not delivered as expected.

title: Merchant Refund Accepted
description: If the merchant or operator has accepted a refund or cancellation, the customer is fully eligible for a refund to the source account.

title: Cancelled Payment or Booking
description: Customers may request confirmation of the status and reason for any payment or booking marked cancelled in the system.

title: Payment Proof Verification
description: Claims that depend on a screenshot or bank statement need verification of that proof before any refund is issued.

title: Double Debit Refund
description: Customers are eligible for a full refund of the extra amount if a duplicate debit for the same payment is detected within 7 days.

title: Wrong Beneficiary Transfer
description: If money was sent to a wrong UPI ID or account, transaction logs must be reviewed and the recipient bank contacted before any recovery is promised.

title: Account Security Review
description: Any suspected unauthorized transaction or account access must be escalated to the security team for manual review before any account or payment action is taken.

title: Payment Not Received by Beneficiary
description: If a transaction shows as successful but the receiver or merchant disputes receipt, bank proof (UTR) must be obtained before resolution.

title: Pending or Delayed Transaction
description: If a transaction stays in processing beyond its expected settlement date, the customer is eligible for a priority follow-up or a refund of the amount.
